Before embarking on our journey to understand Fermat's Last Theorem, it is important to establish a common ground for some mathematical concepts that will be used throughout this project, such
as multivariate functions, differentiation and integration, and complex numbers.

Just as an illustration, the simulation below demonstrates the (numeric) integration of a multivariate function using polar coordinates:

$$
f(\theta, \phi) = \theta^2 (\phi - \pi)^2
$$
